entry.title: Market brief — 25 Nov 2026 close
entry.summary: Indian market brief in plain English: on Wednesday 25 November 2026 the Nifty 50 closed at 25,819.25 (+469.60, +1.85%) and the Sensex at 83,938.28 (+1,502.29, +1.82%), rebounding from Monday's slide as foreign inflows returned and crude softened. The rupee closed at 92.23 per dollar, an eight-month high, and IBJA's 12:00 IST benchmark put 24K gold at ₹1,21,310 per 10 g (-3.05%) and 999 silver at ₹1,43,522 per kg (-6.16%). Every figure is checked against two independent sources dated 25 November 2026. The next session is Thursday 26 November 2026. Education, not advice.
